purpose: Training-OOF-only feasibility audit for a future globally constrained, soft topology-aware 3D module.

scope.interpretation_boundary: Coordinate proximity in a predicted structure is a candidate-contact statistic, not evidence of a native disulfide bond, cyclization state, or experimentally verified topology.

geometry.chemical_distance: Cys SG--SG Euclidean distance in Angstrom, isolated by sequence identity plus a valid sulfur pseudo-site
geometry.pair_confidence: minimum residue pLDDT across the two Cys positions
orientation_outputs: absolute alignment of each Cys CB-to-SG direction with the inter-SG unit vector

evaluation.fold2_policy: Report pooled five-fold results with fold 2 retained as the prespecified prediction-identical zero-chemical fallback, and report active-chemical folds 0,1,3,4 separately.
evaluation.label_standardization: Within each comparison, weight label-specific error rates by the full training-set label proportions.

geometry_heterogeneity.population: peptides with at least two Cys and valid SG geometry

recommendation_levels.go_server_prototype: Data adequacy, geometry heterogeneity, and unmet-model-need criteria all pass.
recommendation_levels.conditional_method_development: Data and geometry criteria pass, but excess current-3D error is not established; topology can be studied as a mechanistic extension but not justified as an expected benchmark correction.
recommendation_levels.no_go: Data adequacy or usable structural-geometry criteria fail.

decision_rule.architecture_boundary: Because the current chemical-site branch already encodes sulfur compatibility, distance, orientation, and pLDDT, a follow-up prototype must add global Cys-pair competition, matching constraints, or weighted candidate-topology aggregation; a second unconstrained local edge MLP is not considered a distinct topology module.
